analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]

· Significantly lower than SMA100 ($134.81)/SMA200 ($124.08): Weakening mid-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (11.0%): Diagnosed at a historically low price level.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (34.5→34.5): Entered oversold territory and remains neutral, with downward pressure dominance.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-2.9187→-3.0876): Continued bearish expansion, maintaining downtrend signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $40.81): Approaching the lower band, with a high volatility band width of 101.75%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($49.33): Higher than the 5-day low ($40.59), providing support for a potential short-term bounce.
· Swing Resistance ($57.78): Close to the current price ($55.38), a breakout would confirm a short-term rebound attempt.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (5-day low $40.59, 20-day low $40.59): Range-bound, lacking directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.63x): Lower than average volume, reducing confidence in the move.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Downtrend): Potential for a short-term bounce exists, but trend reversal signals are weak; conditions for observation met.
